verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm Copilot can review code and give feedback, including one-click suggested changes and High/Medium/Low severity labels, and plans include code review access. However, the evidence frames review as something you request. Event-triggered automations are documented only for the cloud agent, not for automatic review of every PR. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic review on every pull request, detail on how repository context informs the feedback, and independent or hands-on corroboration of review quality.
